tvShow.name: La Isla de las Tentaciones
tvShow.overview: Five couples at a critical moment in their relationship search for the answer to the big question: Are they made for each other? The participants will live apart but they will not be alone. They will live with ten single men and ten single women who want to find love. When this experience is over, they will have to decide how they want to return home: with their partner, alone or with their new love.

episodes.name: Heading to temptation island (1)
episodes.overview: Casting, making, and the new single men and women.

episodes.name: Heading to temptation island (2)
episodes.overview: The program shows the final casting of the five chosen couples who will star in 'La isla de las tentaciones 5', in which they will comment on what each one of them is like, what their relationship is like and what expectations they have before starting the experience. In addition, the images of their respective farewells and an exclusive preview of the new edition of the format.

episodes.name: The experience begins
episodes.overview: The five couples from 'La isla de las tentaciones 5' separate and begin an adventure that will mark them for the rest of their lives. The presentations of the suitors, the first confidences, the selection of favorites, and the first doubts.

episodes.name: The temptations debate: The first party and the first temptation light
episodes.overview: Sandra Barneda leads a first debate loaded with unpublished images of the first hours of coexistence in Villa Playa and Villa Paraíso.

episodes.name: The first uncomfortable images
episodes.overview: The couples face the first parties, the first confidences, the first brushes, the first lights of temptation, and the first images of urgency due to what happened in one of the villas.

episodes.name: The temptations debate 2: Rosario's great surprise to discover that her ex is the new tempter
episodes.overview: The new installment of 'Temptations debate' has brought with it many exclusive news. In addition to new unpublished images, we discovered the identity of the second VIP tempter of the edition: Álvaro Boix. And, as in every program of 'The Island of Temptations', his entry into Villa Playa came with a surprise.

episodes.name: The first bonfire night
episodes.overview: The boys finish seeing the images of their partners and the girls face their first bonfire. In addition, new images of the first infidelity in Villa Playa and the first eliminations take place, the choice of the favorite singles for the second dates, and the arrival of Álvaro Boix as a VIP single.
